item.title: Week 10: Chiefs at Falcons
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: KC -3 · O/U 47.5 | Model ATL 37% vs. market 39% | On paper Kansas City has the edge (Kansas City ranks 3rd in EPA per play-action dropback, +0.25), while Atlanta's best counter is to keep the pocket clean (Atlanta ranks 1st in QB hit + sack rate, 11%). Under center, Patrick Mahomes ranks 8th of 31 in EPA per dropback and Michael Penix Jr. ranks 22nd; x-factor: Drake London gets 27% of Atlanta's targets and 37% of its air yards, and Kansas City's pass defense ranks 23rd. The model favors Kansas City at 63%, mostly on rushing matchup (2.2 pts) and starting QB (1.9 pts).
